Name: Manipulate Fruit Trees
Author: sexynes
Description:
This mod allows users to either grow fruit trees, or convert fruit trees to another type. Converting fruit trees can either be converted among vanilla fruit trees (Apple, Apricot, Banana, Cherry, Mango, Orange, Peach, and Pomegranate), or converted to a modded fruit tree, if the modded fruit tree ID is known. 

[b]Instructions[/b] 
[list=1]
[*]Access Generic Mod Config Menu -> select (CP) Manipulate Fruit Trees 
[*]Set Action to GrowFruitTree or ConvertFruitTree -> manipulate settings for the desired effect 
[*]Save & Close 
[*]Once menu is closed -> reaccess GMCM -> set Action to None -> Save & Close 
[/list]
[b]Optional[/b] 
[list]
[*]If a modded fruit tree ID is known, one can convert to that fruit tree by typing the ID into ConvertToModdedFruitTree; anything typed will override ConvertToWhichFruit. 
[/list]
[b]Universal Settings[/b] 
[list]
[*]Action: None, GrowFruitTree, or ConvertFruitTree. 
[*]NearbyDistance: Number of tiles from the player to convert. 
[*]AllowMaximumDistance: If selected, there is a maximum number of fruit trees to change. 
[*]AllowPercentChange: If selected, there is a percent chance any given fruit tree will be changed. Default: 1.0. 
[/list]
[b]GrowFruitTree[/b] 
[list]
[*]SetDaysToGrow: If selected, fruit tree will grow the determined number of days. Default: 1. 
[*]SetMaxNumberOfFruitOnTree: If selected, there is a maximum number of fruits to grow on a tree. Default: 3. 
[/list]
[b]ConvertFruitTree[/b] [list]
[*]ConvertToWhichFruitTree: Convert fruit trees into the selected fruit. 
[*]ChangeFruit: If selected, any existing fruit will be changed to match the new tree type. 
[*]OnlyMature: If selected, only mature fruit trees will be converted. 
[*]AllowSetDays: If selected, the selected number will determine how many days the fruit tree will mature. Default: 1. 
[*]ConvertToModdedFruitTree: To convert to a modded fruit tree, type in the modded fruit tree ID, once known. 
[/list]
[b]Caution[/b] 
[list]
[*]Every time a menu is closed, the game automatically applies effects from this mod. Hence, set Action to None in the config menu before going to another area or closing a menu. 
[*]Setting a fruit tree to an earlier growth time is feasible; however, setting a fruit tree to a later growth time may be more complicated: converting to another fruit tree type, and converting back. 
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Manipulate Fruit Trees
Manifest.Description: Grow or convert fruit trees in a map.
